verdict: Organic presence holding; paid channels remain off and GBP is softening.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every lead came from Google Business Profile — no paid campaigns ran on Meta or Google Ads for the full 28 days. Combined, your three profiles drove 399 total actions (28 calls, 246 direction requests, and 125 website clicks), which shows real market interest without any ad spend behind it. That said, GBP engagement fell week-over-week at all three locations — down 29% at Forte Metals, 12% at Advance Grinding, and 46% at O'Hare Precision — so organic alone is not a stable lead engine at this volume. CRM setup milestones are being resolved this month to unblock outreach sequences, and a web tracking fix is in motion so site traffic becomes measurable again. Expect paid activity and structured outreach to come online in the next reporting cycle, which will give you the first real cost-per-lead numbers.
